name: com.siilostomy/guides
title: SIIL Ostomy Daily Life & Recovery Guides (20 Languages)
description: Search 2,797 SIIL ostomy daily-life, recovery, sleep, sport and intimacy guides in 20 languages.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description:
Search published SIIL guides (clothing, hiding the bag, swimming, travel, sport, intimacy, recovery, support,
    everyday life and care information).

    Args:
        query: What the person wants to know, in any supported language (e.g. "how to hide an ostomy bag under a dress").
        lang: Optional language code: en, en-gb, es, fr, de, it, pl, ja, cs, sv, da, fi, nl, pt, sk, nb, hu, ro, el.
        country: Optional ISO country code (US, GB, ES, FR, DE, IT, MX ...). Used to pick the language when `lang` is empty.
        topic: Optional topic id from list_topics (hiding-the-bag, clothing, swimwear-water, travel, sport-active,
            intimacy, recovery, support-confidence, everyday-life, basics, health-info).
        limit: Max results (1-10, default 5).

    Returns canonical URLs, quick answers and summaries. Always cite `url`.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description:
Get one published SIIL guide by URL: title, quick answer, summary, outline, canonical URL, language, dates,
    and the same guide in other languages/countries (hreflang siblings).

    Args:
        url: Guide URL from search_guides (canonical, or a non-canonical variant of it). If the page's canonical
            points to another guide we serve, that guide is returned (`redirected_from` / `canonical_hint`).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description:
List guide topics with how many guides exist in a language, plus example guides.

    Args:
        lang: Optional language code (en, en-gb, es, fr, de, it, pl ...). Default en.

tools.name: get_brand_facts
tools.description:
What SIIL Ostomy is and is not (a clothing brand that also publishes information and support guides; does
    not make pouches), product families, languages and stores, shipping, customer rating, and
    how to cite.
